scope: Synthetic malformed-profile DDL, applied only in private test fixtures. Not production validation or repair SQL.

columns-and-keys.column-collation: alter table %1$s.lg4jthread alter column thread_name type varchar(255) collate "C"
columns-and-keys.type: alter table %1$s.lg4jthread alter column thread_name type text
columns-and-keys.nullability: alter table %1$s.lg4jcheckpoint alter column state_data drop not null
columns-and-keys.default: alter table %1$s.lg4jthread alter column is_released set default true
columns-and-keys.foreign-key: alter table %1$s.lg4jcheckpoint drop constraint fk_thread; alter table %1$s.lg4jcheckpoint add constraint fk_thread foreign key(thread_id) references %1$s.lg4jthread(thread_id) on delete restrict
columns-and-keys.extra-column: alter table %1$s.lg4jthread add column unknown_extension text

indexes.predicate: drop index %1$s.idx_unique_lg4jthread_thread_name_unreleased; create unique index idx_unique_lg4jthread_thread_name_unreleased on %1$s.lg4jthread(thread_name) where is_released=true
indexes.sort-order: drop index %1$s.idx_lg4jcheckpoint_thread_id_saved_at_desc; create index idx_lg4jcheckpoint_thread_id_saved_at_desc on %1$s.lg4jcheckpoint(thread_id,saved_at asc)
indexes.nulls-not-distinct: drop index %1$s.idx_unique_lg4jthread_thread_name_unreleased; create unique index idx_unique_lg4jthread_thread_name_unreleased on %1$s.lg4jthread(thread_name) nulls not distinct where is_released=false

policies.row-security: alter table %1$s.lg4jthread enable row level security
policies.check: alter table %1$s.lg4jthread add constraint unknown_business_rule check(thread_name<>'never')
policies.trigger: create function %1$s.must_not_run() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin raise exception 'unexpected fixture trigger invocation'; end; $$; create trigger unknown_profile_hook before update on %1$s.lg4jthread for each row execute function %1$s.must_not_run()
